This camera was planed as second war machine available in Courtyard. This mysterious machine can cast spells 5 times per battle. Camera can cast Age spell on enemy units (duration - 3 turns) or can revive friedly dead stacks as Apparitions (mechanism similar to Pit Lord's deamon summoning). faction.courtyard.courtyard.description: Courtyard became a refuge for aristocrats and philosophers. Its location on the prison island of Larnia, far from civilization, provided the former inhabitants of Ravenshore with an opportunity to develop alchemical research. The city is home to golem-like Cupids and Homunculi, resistant to mind spells, gunpowder-wielding Musketeers, and terrifying representatives of the local fauna. The faction is rather slow, but new spells, war machines, and the extraordinary abilities of its creatures create opportunities for employing innovative tactics.
faction.courtyard.courtyard.name: Courtyard
hero.courtyard.00auk.name: Auk
hero.courtyard.00auk.specialty.descripti: Increases the speed of Dodos, Battle Dodos, or Greater Dodos by 1. Doubles the efficiency of Battle Dodos' Magic Resistance Aura and they gain a 33% chance to resist hostile spells. Increases the morale of Grand Dodos by 2.
hero.courtyard.00auk.specialty.name: Dodos
hero.courtyard.01caballe.biography: In her slumbersome dreams, young lady Caballe often finds herself at a feast with beverages of fantastical properties. Although she never tasted any of them herself, she always wakes up with precise knowledge of how to create such drinks.
hero.courtyard.01caballe.name: Caballe
hero.courtyard.01caballe.specialty.descr: Creatures of good alignment gain +1 morale when under the effect of potions. Creatures of neutral alignment gain +1 luck instead.
hero.courtyard.01caballe.specialty.name: Potion Benefits
hero.courtyard.02kanim.biography: Kanim once was a highwayman robbing elves on the contested lands of Harmondale, excusing himself with abhorrent humanist ideology. This changed when he was ambushed by Kreegans only to be saved by despised elves, an event that changed his outlook. Today many reformed fugitives from Jadame join his mercenary company.
hero.courtyard.02kanim.name: Kanim
hero.courtyard.02kanim.specialty.descrip: Increases the speed of Arquebusiers or Musketeers by 1, their shots by 5, and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.courtyard.02kanim.specialty.name: Arquebusiers
hero.courtyard.03lumiere.biography: Lumiere had to abandon luxury of elven nobility and live among hunters of Tularean Forest to escape war. She quickly learned the art of guerilla warfare, impressing even experienced rangers with her elaborate traps. Despite mingling back into the high society when she left to Larnia, Lumiere still has no qualms using dirty tricks on the battlefield.
hero.courtyard.03lumiere.name: Lumiere
hero.courtyard.03lumiere.specialty.descr: Arquebusiers and Musketeers randomly place Land Mines, Quicksand, or Force Fields upon the battlefield every few rounds.
hero.courtyard.03lumiere.specialty.name: Battlefield Impediments
hero.courtyard.04dizheel.biography: The noblewoman known as Dizheel is a charismatic leader. Wherever she appears, it is not rare for common folk, mercenaries and even lesser lords to join her cause whatever it might be.
hero.courtyard.04dizheel.name: Dizheel
hero.courtyard.04dizheel.specialty.descr: Receives a 1% bonus to Diplomacy skill percentage for every 4 levels.
hero.courtyard.04dizheel.specialty.name: Diplomacy
hero.courtyard.05raphus.biography: Upon finding himself unsuccessful in The School of Sorcery in Bracada, Raphus abandoned his formal education. However the practical skill in golem enchanting and his creativity made him a renowned mage-artist in Larnia, popular for the expressive living statues he sculpts.
hero.courtyard.05raphus.name: Raphus
hero.courtyard.05raphus.specialty.descri: Increases the speed of Marble and Granite Cupids by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up). Casts Expert Reconstruction.
hero.courtyard.05raphus.specialty.name: Cupids
hero.courtyard.06ophrys.biography: Other mandrakes consider Ophrys' voice to be quiet and weak and they do not regard her highly. This however makes her voice bearable to human ears, allowing her to coordinate efforts between them and her capricious kin.
hero.courtyard.06ophrys.name: Ophrys
hero.courtyard.06ophrys.specialty.descri: Increases the health of Mandrakes and Regal Mandrakes by 5. Increases the speed of Vines by 1 and grants them Preemptive Retaliation.
hero.courtyard.06ophrys.specialty.name: Mandrakes
hero.courtyard.07teophrast.biography: Unlike most of the dark elves of Jadame Theophrast didn't arrive as a refugee or exile. This industrious man sees Larnia for what it is, growing settlements that need to be built and expanded, and he is the one who can provide the building materials cheap thanks to his trade contacts.
hero.courtyard.07teophrast.name: Teophrast
hero.courtyard.07teophrast.specialty.des: Increases kingdom's wood and ore production by +1 Wood and Ore per day for every 7 levels.
hero.courtyard.08audred.biography: This prodigy alchemist, while still too young to even attend magical university, turned to research in artifical creation of life prohibited in Bracada. After one horrible accident he blames on having to work in secrecy, he fled to Larnia to be quickly accepted as the lead Homunculi researcher.
hero.courtyard.08audred.name: Audred
hero.courtyard.08audred.specialty.descri: Increases the speed of Homunculi or Gilded Homunculi by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.courtyard.08audred.specialty.name: Homunculi
hero.courtyard.09migdigravia.biography: Despite her gentle and warm perosnality, Migdigvarvia's pasttime involves designing contraptions of horrid curses. When she was denied a Warlock title in Nighon, she simply left in disapproval of its culture. In Larnia she is admired for her carefree attitude, even if at the same time feared for her dreadful devices.
hero.courtyard.09migdigravia.name: Migdigravia
hero.courtyard.09migdigravia.specialty.d: The Camera Obscura gains 3 additional spell casts and can revive dead units as Ephemeral Apparitions.
hero.courtyard.10vogundessi.biography: When alchemists were unsuccessful prying out secrets of Vogundessi's craft from him, they announced him a fraud to ruin his reputation and sentenced to shameful execution. He escaped this sordid fate supposedly by striking a deal with devils, but barely anyone believe these accusations in Larnia.
hero.courtyard.10vogundessi.name: Vogundessi
hero.courtyard.10vogundessi.specialty.de: Increases kingdom's income by 50 gold per level per day.
hero.courtyard.11nefefareen.biography: Given her old age even for an efreet, it was surprising that Nefefareen travelled beyond the Plane of Fire, especially that she wasn't interested in wars waged by Devils. It is not known what is the purpose of her meddling in Larnia, but she's the one who popularized keeping Salamanders as pets and servants.
hero.courtyard.11nefefareen.name: Nefefareen
hero.courtyard.11nefefareen.specialty.de: Salamanders and Shiny Salamanders are susceptible to positive fire spells. When under effect of Fire Shield they gain +2 speed and damage, positive morale, and a 33% chance to cast Immolation after attack.
hero.courtyard.12hanester.biography: Hanester initially was not interested in much beside researching philosopher stone in peace, until she realized how easily it can bring out the worst qualities of people. Seeing the increading greed and madness over this precius mineral, this bright scientist decided to intervene.
hero.courtyard.12hanester.name: Hanester
hero.courtyard.12hanester.specialty.desc: Lowers the power skill of the enemy hero by 15%, and by an additional 1% for every 2 levels.
hero.courtyard.12hanester.specialty.name: Disruption
hero.courtyard.13dictamnus.biography: When asked why plantfolk would use conjured flames, Dictamnus always asks in return if fire is any less deadly to humans and if it ever stopped them from wielding it. He had sworn to his clan to fight any invasive species threatening Larnia, especially floral ones. And for that, fire is especially useful.
hero.courtyard.13dictamnus.name: Dictamnus
hero.courtyard.13dictamnus.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to offensive Fire Magic spells.
hero.courtyard.14zana.biography: Nobody in their sane mind would believe Zana's improbable stories of travels to places like Vori or Fiery Moon, if not for a fact that she has uncanny habit of being found whimsically treading places most unexpected, and she has extensive knowledge of many secret areas. This granted her the position of Larnia's Royal Cartographer.
hero.courtyard.14zana.name: Zana
hero.courtyard.14zana.specialty.descript: Always casts Dimension Door at expert level.
hero.courtyard.14zana.specialty.name: Dimension Door
hero.courtyard.15zazzerpan.biography: The only thing more legendary than Zazzerpan's magic skill was his complacency. When he was defeated by a student in a magic duel, he revoked all his academic titles, and fled Bracada abruptly in shame. Among Larnians he still insists not to be called professor, as he has not yet recovered from his sense of failure.
hero.courtyard.15zazzerpan.name: Zazzerpan
hero.courtyard.15zazzerpan.specialty.des: Negates the natural spell immunities of all creatures in combat.
